status: Final native audit, both exports, and fourteen composite captures verified

segments.label: Funky strut
segments.description: Traveling groove with hip, chest, shoulder, and head motion.

segments.label: Running man
segments.description: Blend into alternating running-man footwork over the first 0.6 beat.

segments.label: Quick grab accent
segments.description: Brief low hand accent; the other arm counters overhead.

segments.label: Gather feet
segments.description: Bring the feet together and prepare the side hops.

segments.label: Directional side hops
segments.description: Three hops with directional body lean, loading, push-off, airborne leg tuck, and landing absorption. Lateral flight has short acceleration ramps.

segments.label: Backstep groove
segments.description: Blend back to the strut over 0.55 beat while traveling back.

segments.label: Heel-toe groove
segments.description: Blend into heel-toe footwork and loose upper-body waves.

segments.label: Shimmy entry
segments.description: Blend into the new alternating heel-toe shimmy over 0.75 beat.

segments.label: Heel-toe shimmy
segments.description: Grounded alternating foot lifts, hip/chest counterrotation, and arm swing; replaces the second hop group.

segments.label: Floorwork preparation
segments.description: Blend the shimmy into the upright wave pose.

segments.label: Drop
segments.description: Lower the live upright pose into a planted crouch.

segments.label: Hand plant
segments.description: Blend the drop into the two-hand kick-up support pose.

segments.label: Kick-up
segments.description: Raise the pelvis and legs into the handstand.

segments.label: Handstand
segments.description: Alternating leg motion over planted hands.

segments.label: Release
segments.description: Brief release of the palms from the handstand.

segments.label: Shoulder flop
segments.description: Accelerating fold onto the shoulder and upper back.

segments.label: Backspin entry
segments.description: Catch the upper back and carry the leg drive into rotation.

segments.label: Driven backspin
segments.description: Scissoring legs, tucked arms, chin tuck, and torso curl drive the spin.

segments.label: Spin brake
segments.description: Ease rotational speed while staying on the upper back.

segments.label: Brake and roll overlap
segments.description: Unfold into the side roll while the remaining spin brakes.

segments.label: Side recline
segments.description: Rotation integral has stopped; the pose continues rolling.

segments.label: Cheek-rest reach
segments.description: Blend the supported side recline into the cheek-rest pose.

segments.label: Ground freeze hold
segments.description: Hold the supported final pose through exactly 20 seconds.

late_finale_note: The side roll starts at b30.4 while the spin brakes. Spin angle stops accumulating at b31.25; head-rest reach begins at b31.9; the smooth quadratic pose blend finishes at b33.2 without an intermediate freeze.
